contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Switzerland's Roche will pay USD 75 million upfront to Simcere Pharmaceutical Group for rights ‌to an ⁠experimental ⁠blood cancer drug, the Chinese drugmaker said Tuesday.

SIM0660 targets B-cell malignancies, Simcere said in a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange.B ​cells are a ⁠type of ‌white blood cell ​that ​produces antibodies. Simcere is also ⁠eligible to receive up to ​about $1.46 billion in payments for unspecified ​milestones.

Roche will receive exclusive global rights to develop, manufacture and commercialise SIM0660.

A Simcere spokesperson told Reuters ‌SIM0660 is a preclinical product. Roche did not immediately ​respond to ​a ⁠request for comment on what specific diseases it intended to study SIM0660 for, ​or potential clinical trial timelines.

Source : Reuters
